The '''Great Mothers' Fortress''' was built into a [[mountain]] on the [[extragalactic]] [[planet]] [[Peridea]], where it served as the seat of power for the [[Dathomirian|Dathmiri]] [[witch]]es calling themselves the [[Great Mothers]]. The fortress included an underground [[temple]] as well as a tall spire topped with a circular [[henge]].<ref name="Part 6" /> It also served as the base of operations for [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] "Thrawn"'s [[Battle of Peridea|escape from Peridea]]. It was destroyed by Thrawn in an effort to slow down the [[Jedi]] pursuing him.

==History==
The Great Mothers' Fortress<ref name="Databank">{{Databank|great-mothers-fortress|Great Mothers' Fortress}}</ref> was a fortress built into a [[mountain]] on the [[extragalactic]] [[planet]] [[Peridea]] in the [[Far galaxy]]. It served as the lair of the the ancient [[Dathomirian]] [[Great Mothers]] of the [[Witch Kingdom of the Dathmiri]],<ref name="Part 6" /> which had been founded by [[25,025 BBY]].<ref name="25k Date">"[[Darkness Rising]]" establishes that the Great Mothers were around before the [[Jedi Order]], which was founded around [[25,025 BBY]] per ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''.</ref> Eventually the Witches entered a type of hibernation sleep, during this time the [[far galaxy]] entered a [[Far galaxy war|war]], which rendered the galaxy and Peridea largely dead and barren.<ref name="Darkness Rising">{{HomeVideoCite|set=Ahsoka: The Complete First Season|featurette=Darkness Rising}}</ref> [[Unidentified runic alphabet|Runes]] on the Great Mothers' Fortress also made mention of<ref name="Part 6" /> the [[Zeffo]] [[Zeffo Sage|Sage]] [[Kujet]].<ref name="JFO">''[[Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order]]''</ref>

===Thrawn's alliance===
Many thousands of years later, Grand Admiral Mitth'raw'nuruodo found the fortress and awoke the mothers within, after being exiled from [[The galaxy|his home galaxy]] during the [[Liberation of Lothal]]<ref name="Part 6" />in [[1 BBY]].<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> He made an alliance with them, utilizing their [[magick]] to repair his [[Star Destroyer]], the ''[[Chimaera]]'', and to contact [[Morgan Elsbeth|one of his agents]] in the main galaxy. In return, Thrawn would take the mothers and their cargo with him.<ref name="Part 6" />

===Escape from Peridea===
[[File:TanoAgainstMorganAndNightTroopers-Ahsoka.png|thumb|left|300px|Morgan Elsbeth confronts Ahsoka Tano atop the Great Mothers' Fortress during the battle of Peridea.]]
After traveling through extragalactic hyperspace, Thrawn's agent, Morgan Elsbeth arrived above Peridea aboard the ''[[Eye of Sion]]'', intended to ferry Thrawn and the Great Mothers to [[Dathomir]]. She and her mercenaries arrived at the fortress and were greeted by the mothers. Soon afterward, the ''Chimaera'' docked over the fortress and began transferring the cargo onboard.<ref name="Part 6" /> Thrawn orchestrated the efforts to use [[Sabine Wren]] to find and kill [[Ezra Bridger]] from here as well as the interception of [[Ahsoka Tano]].<ref name="Part 7">{{Ahsoka|Part Seven: Dreams and Madness}}</ref> Although the [[Jedi]] survived, the cargo transfer was completed and preparations for departure were begun.<ref name="Part 8" /> In what became known as the [[battle of Peridea]],<ref name="GoH">''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes]]''</ref> Tano, Wren, and Bridger infiltrated the fortress to prevent it, but Morgan stayed behind to buy Thrawn and the Mothers more time, long enough to leave the fortress.<ref name="Part 8" />

===Destruction===
In an effort to halt the Jedi's advance, Thrawn ordered the ''Chimaera's'' [[turbolaser]]s to fire on the fortress, noticeably upsetting the Great Mothers. Tano and Wren narrowly escaped, but the reanimated [[Night Trooper]]s were destroyed when it crumbled.<ref name="Part 8" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Great Mothers' Fortress first appeared in "[[Part Six: Far, Far Away]]", the sithxth episode of the live-action TV series ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka]]'', which was written by series' creator [[Dave Filoni]] and directed by [[Jennifer Getzinger]]<ref name="Part 6" /> and was released on [[September 19]], [[2023]].<ref name="Ep Date">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1692552080764887366|Star Wars|quote=.Thank you to all the fans who celebrated with us at our @AhsokaOfficial fan events around the world last night! We're excited to announce that new episodes of #Ahsoka will now launch Tuesdays at 6PM PT, starting with our two-episode premiere on August 22, only on @DisneyPlus.|archivedate=20230818152836}}</ref>

The visual design of the fortress is similar<ref name="Part 6" /> to that of the city of [[Wikipedia:Minas Tirith|Minas Tirith]] in [[Wikipedia:The Lord of the Rings (film series)|''The Lord of the Rings'' film series]],<ref name="LotR RotK film">[[Wikipedia:The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King (film)|''The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King'' (2003 film)]]</ref> of which Filoni is a fan of and which has served as inspiration for Ahsoka Tano in the series.<ref name="Best of Jedi">{{SW|url=news/rosario-dawson-ahsoka-tano-interview|text=The Best of the Jedi: Rosario Dawson on Bringing Ahsoka Tano to Live-Action and ''The Mandalorian''}}</ref> Similarly, other parts of Peredia like the [[Monument to the Ones]] and the general terrain of the grasslands are also reminiscent<ref name="Part 8" /> of the depictions of the lands of [[Wikipedia:Gondor|Gondor]].<ref name="LotR RotK film" />
